Howdy all,


We’ve rolled out WP Workbench 2.0.6 plugin for all Virtualmin Pro users.


Changes since 2.0.5:


- Fix to skip loading plugins and themes code in WP-CLI calls to avoid fatal errors
- Fix to correctly handle errors from WP-CLI output
